primary.description: Default first-line changes with a narrow blast radius and a direct connection to observed call behavior, primarily prompt and greeting changes.

feature.description: Use or correct an existing HighLevel capability when prompt wording alone cannot supply data, execute an action, or complete an operational workflow.

advanced.description: Speech, model, system-prompt, and other high-coupling settings that require stronger causal evidence and explicit testing before adoption.

suggestions.title: Clarify the agent's role, flow, and success criteria
signals: The agent skips an explicit requirement
The agent follows an ambiguous instruction in a harmful or unhelpful way
The call exposes a missing branch or fallback
guardrails: Propose an exact minimal diff
Preserve unrelated instructions and custom values
Do not solve missing knowledge or missing tools with invented prompt facts
validation: Run the failing scenario and at least one unaffected happy path
Review transcript, action use, and outcome before applying

suggestions.title: Clarify when and how an existing action should be used
requiredEvidence: executed action evidence or a conclusive missed trigger
signals: A configured action is invoked under the wrong condition
The prompt omits the trigger or required preconditions
The agent announces an action but does not invoke it
guardrails: Never infer failure from an empty action list without knowing the action configuration
Separate prompt-trigger defects from action configuration or downstream execution failures
validation: Test positive, negative, and boundary trigger scenarios
Confirm the expected action ID and result

suggestions.title: Add a safe fallback or explicit boundary
requiredEvidence: quoted unsupported, unsafe, or fabricated response
signals: The agent invents business information
The agent does not know how to handle an unsupported request
The agent should escalate or collect a message instead of continuing
guardrails: Prefer a narrow condition and next step over a blanket refusal
Do not promise a handoff mechanism that is not configured
validation: Retest the original failure
Test a supported neighboring request to prevent over-refusal

suggestions.title: Correct or specialize the inbound/outbound greeting
suggestions.uiPath: Build > Welcome Message > Inbound or Outbound
signals: Wrong business or agent identity
Outbound purpose is not explained
Greeting language or tone conflicts with the configured audience
guardrails: Do not claim separate inbound/outbound API writes because the public API documents one welcomeMessage field
Preserve required disclosures
validation: Run one inbound and one outbound opening test when both are used

suggestions.title: Adjust the pause before the greeting
suggestions.uiPath: Build > Welcome Message > Pause Before Speaking
requiredEvidence: call recording or timestamped audio events
signals: The greeting is clipped by call connection audio
Callers repeatedly speak over the opening
The opening delay is conspicuously long
guardrails: Never infer this from transcript text alone
Do not recommend a numeric value without audio evidence
validation: Compare test calls at the current and proposed delay

suggestions.title: Use a HighLevel custom value for stable business-specific text
suggestions.uiPath: Build > Prompt or message field > Custom Value
signals: The same mutable business detail is duplicated across prompts
A wrong location-specific value appears in a call
guardrails: Only reference an existing verified custom value
Do not put sensitive contact data into a static location value
validation: Preview the resolved value and place a test call

suggestions.title: Create or attach a knowledge base
requiredEvidence: a legitimate factual question the agent could not answer
verification that the answer belongs in maintained business knowledge
signals: The prompt would need to embed substantial or frequently changing facts
The caller asks about policies, products, services, pricing, or documentation
The same knowledge need is likely to recur
guardrails: Do not recommend a knowledge base for conversational behavior rules
Voice AI supports one attached knowledge base per agent
Do not invent the missing source content
validation: Add a trusted source
Use the retrieval tester
Test the original customer-style question through the voice agent

suggestions.title: Add or correct knowledge-base content
suggestions.uiPath: AI Agents > Knowledge Base > Source tabs
signals: The agent cannot find a documented answer
Retrieved content is stale, incomplete, or contradictory
A source omits a common synonym or customer phrasing
guardrails: Do not diagnose retrieval from transcript alone
Require a trusted source owner for factual changes
Remove duplicates rather than adding another conflicting copy
validation: Run the retrieval tester
Verify source attribution
Retest the failing call scenario

suggestions.title: Refine when the agent queries its knowledge base
suggestions.uiPath: Build > Knowledge Base > When to use this knowledge base
signals: The KB was not queried for an in-scope factual question
The KB was queried for an unrelated request
The trigger condition is vague or overlaps unrelated intents
guardrails: Do not rewrite KB content when the defect is trigger selection
Keep the trigger description specific and intent-based
validation: Test positive and negative trigger examples
Confirm retrieval occurs only for in-scope questions

suggestions.title: Clean up stale, duplicate, or poorly structured sources
suggestions.uiPath: AI Agents > Knowledge Base > Web Crawler, FAQ, Web Search, Tables, Rich Text, or File Upload
signals: Wrong sources repeatedly outrank the correct source
Multiple sources contradict one another
Image-only or unstructured documents omit searchable text
A structured table would better represent catalog or pricing data
guardrails: Do not delete sources automatically
Preserve source provenance and review ownership
validation: Run representative retrieval questions before and after cleanup
Confirm citations point to the intended source

suggestions.title: Add or correct a human call-transfer action
suggestions.uiPath: Build > Actions > During the Call > Call Transfer
signals: The caller explicitly requests a person
The agent reaches a high-risk or unsupported case requiring live help
Repeated routing requests belong to a known team
guardrails: Do not suggest a destination number or schedule that has not been verified
Distinguish transfer failure from a missing transfer capability
validation: Test in-hours, out-of-hours, and unavailable-destination behavior

suggestions.title: Route a specialized intent to another Voice AI agent
signals: One agent prompt has become overloaded with unrelated specialties
Calls repeatedly require a specialized language, department, or workflow
A destination agent already owns the requested domain
guardrails: Do not fragment a simple flow unnecessarily
Validate that destination-agent working-hours behavior during chained transfer matches HighLevel rules
validation: Test routing conditions, handoff message, context continuity, and destination fallback

suggestions.title: Add or correct appointment booking
suggestions.uiPath: Build > Actions > During the Call > Book Appointment
signals: A qualified caller wants to schedule but receives only a promise of follow-up
The wrong calendar is selected
The agent offers unsuitable slots or misses required booking details
guardrails: Confirm calendar availability, buffers, minimum notice, conflicts, and fallback
Do not recommend Services because current Voice AI booking supports single or multiple calendars, not Services
validation: Use a test contact and calendar
Test booking, no-match, missing-email, and rejection paths

suggestions.title: Trigger a workflow at the correct call event
signals: A deterministic follow-up should occur after a qualifying call
The workflow runs during the wrong phase
A configured post-call workflow does not match the intended outcome
guardrails: Distinguish during-call actions from call-end workflows
Do not create or enable a workflow without reviewing its downstream effects
validation: Run with a test contact
Inspect workflow enrollment and downstream side effects

suggestions.title: Send an SMS when spoken information is insufficient
suggestions.uiPath: Build > Actions > During the Call > Send SMS
requiredEvidence: clear need for a link or written confirmation
signals: The caller needs a booking, payment, map, document, or other link
The agent repeatedly spells a long URL
A written confirmation would prevent misunderstanding
guardrails: Respect consent and messaging compliance
Do not send sensitive data or unverified links
Avoid duplicate sends
validation: Test delivery to a test contact and verify exact message content

suggestions.title: Persist information collected during the call
suggestions.uiPath: Build > Actions > After the Call > Update Contact Fields
signals: The agent collects useful qualification or support data that is lost after the call
A wrong field is updated
Required data is collected but absent from the CRM
guardrails: Map values to verified field semantics
Do not infer or store sensitive attributes
Keep unknown or refused answers distinct from empty values
validation: Use a test contact and inspect the resulting field values

suggestions.title: Use a custom action or MCP tool for an external capability
suggestions.uiPath: Build > Actions > Custom Action or Add MCP
signals: The required operation cannot be completed by native Voice AI actions
Callers repeatedly need a safe lookup or transaction in an external system
guardrails: Prefer native actions when available
Require strict input schemas, least privilege, idempotency, timeouts, and safe failure messaging
Never propose an arbitrary external call from transcript text alone
validation: Test success, timeout, invalid input, duplicate invocation, and downstream rejection

suggestions.title: Adjust the idle reminder behavior
suggestions.uiPath: Build > Call Settings > Idle Reminder Timer
signals: The reminder interrupts normal thinking time
Long silence makes callers think the call disconnected
The call ends after an ill-timed silence reminder
guardrails: Use the documented 1-20 second range
Do not infer silence timing from transcript lines without timestamps or audio
Coordinate with backchannel frequency
validation: Test a deliberate pause before and after the proposed threshold

suggestions.title: Adjust maximum call duration
suggestions.uiPath: Build > Call Settings > Maximum Call Duration
requiredEvidence: calls ending at or near the configured limit
signals: Legitimate calls are cut off at the limit
The configured duration is disproportionate to the intended workflow
guardrails: Do not treat short or long calls as failures by duration alone
Use the documented 180-900 second range
Fix looping behavior before merely raising the limit
validation: Retest the longest legitimate scenario and a looping or abandoned scenario

suggestions.title: Change the agent's live conversation language
signals: The agent consistently responds in the wrong language
The audience requires multilingual behavior
The selected voice is incompatible with the intended language
guardrails: Do not confuse live-call language with post-call translation
Review and test the auto-translated greeting
validation: Run native-speaker test scenarios and review greeting, comprehension, and action use

suggestions.title: Enable or correct transcript and summary translation
signals: Reviewers cannot use the original-language transcript
The configured translation target is wrong
Post-call workflows need translated artifacts
guardrails: Translation affects post-call written output, not the live conversation
The original record remains available
Follow HighLevel language compatibility rules
validation: Complete a test call and inspect original and translated summary/transcript

suggestions.title: Correct post-call workflows or notification recipients
signals: A completed call needs a deterministic follow-up
The wrong team receives call details
Important summaries or action outcomes are not delivered
guardrails: Review transcript privacy before adding recipients
Do not conflate workflow failure with agent conversation quality
HighLevel documents at most 10 call-end workflow IDs
validation: Run a test call and verify workflow enrollment and notification delivery

suggestions.title: Correct phone assignment, working hours, timezone, or backup behavior
signals: The wrong agent receives a number's calls
Calls are handled outside intended hours
Timezone configuration makes schedules incorrect
Backup behavior routes calls unexpectedly
guardrails: Treat this as an operational configuration issue, not conversational quality
Verify number ownership and routing dependencies before changes
validation: Test in-hours, after-hours, and primary-agent-unavailable paths

suggestions.title: Configure an appropriate performance-report cadence and audience
requiredEvidence: agent call volume and operational cadence
signals: Owners repeatedly miss calls requiring review
A stable agent needs periodic oversight without daily dashboard checks
Different stakeholders require agent-specific reporting
guardrails: This improves visibility rather than agent behavior
Avoid unnecessary recipient exposure
The feature may require Labs enablement
validation: Confirm the next report is delivered and linked users have permission to open call details

suggestions.title: Add boosted keywords for repeatedly misrecognized domain terms
requiredEvidence: reviewed audio or trusted ground truth
signals: Brand, product, location, person, or technical terms are transcribed incorrectly
The same recognition error changes intent, retrieval, or action selection
guardrails: Never diagnose an STT error from transcript text alone
Prefer a small verified vocabulary
Do not use boosting to fix wrong TTS pronunciation
validation: Create a pronunciation-varied audio test set and compare recognition before and after

suggestions.title: Correct how the agent pronounces a specific term
signals: The agent audibly mispronounces a brand, place, product, or person's name
The pronunciation causes caller confusion or damages professionalism
guardrails: Do not infer pronunciation from transcript text
Do not confuse caller-to-text recognition with agent text-to-speech pronunciation
validation: Preview or test the exact term in representative sentences and languages

suggestions.title: Review the speech-to-text mode
signals: Broad transcription failures persist beyond a few vocabulary terms
Errors correlate with a documented language or environment mismatch
guardrails: Prefer keyword-level remediation for isolated terms
Do not recommend a mode when its current value and available choices are unknown
validation: Replay a labelled audio set across the available modes and compare task-relevant transcription errors

suggestions.title: Enable or change noise cancellation
signals: Ambient noise causes repeated misunderstandings
Nearby speech competes with the primary caller
Strong suppression appears to remove intended speech
guardrails: Start with Remove Noise before Remove Noise plus Background Speech
The feature may require Labs enablement
Do not infer noise from transcript alone
validation: Test in representative office, car, and public environments
Review whether intended speech is suppressed

suggestions.title: Tune backchannel frequency or phrases
signals: The agent sounds disengaged during long caller turns
Acknowledgements are too frequent, culturally inappropriate, or overlap caller speech
guardrails: Keep phrases short and neutral
Coordinate with idle reminder timing
Do not infer backchannel quality from text-only transcripts
validation: Test long-form caller speech and brief pauses with representative users

suggestions.title: Tune response speed or interruption sensitivity
signals: The agent repeatedly cuts callers off
Long response gaps harm the conversation
The agent fails to yield when the caller interrupts
guardrails: Do not use transcript line order as timing evidence
Change one conversational timing control at a time
Do not confuse model latency with intentional response pacing
validation: Compare interruption-heavy, slow-speaker, and normal-turn test scenarios

suggestions.title: Run a controlled temperature experiment
signals: Repeated tests show excessive variation or rigidity after prompt defects are ruled out
guardrails: Never recommend temperature from one transcript
Do not use temperature as a generic hallucination fix
Hold prompt, model, and scenarios constant
validation: Run repeated scenario tests at the current and one proposed value and inspect consistency and task completion

suggestions.title: Change the voice or voice model
signals: Voice accent, tone, or language conflicts with the audience
Voice quality, latency, and cost trade-offs are unsuitable
A consistent branded voice is required
guardrails: Voice identity is API-writable, but the public agent API does not document the voice-model selector
Do not claim a voice change fixes reasoning or prompt logic
Imported voices are agency-level assets with documented limits
validation: Blind-preview candidate voices with representative scripts
Test latency and intelligibility on phone-quality audio

suggestions.title: Tune voice speed, volume, or background sound
signals: Speech is consistently too fast, slow, quiet, or loud
Background sound reduces clarity or conflicts with the brand
guardrails: Do not infer audible quality from transcripts
Change one output control at a time
Test on telephony audio rather than studio speakers only
validation: Compare recordings across typical devices and caller environments

suggestions.title: Evaluate a different LLM model
signals: Failures persist after prompt, knowledge, and action configuration are correct
The workload has a clear quality-latency-cost mismatch
guardrails: Do not recommend a model from a single bad answer
Hold prompt and configuration constant
Validate action use and latency, not just prose quality
validation: Run the same scenario suite across candidate models and review qualitative failures, action correctness, latency, and cost

suggestions.title: Edit the relevant exposed system-prompt module
requiredEvidence: repeatable failure tied to personality, booking, date/time, numbers/symbols, or email confirmation
signals: A foundational behavior conflicts with the business despite a correct agent prompt
Date/time interpretation, number speech, or email confirmation repeatedly follows an unsuitable default
guardrails: Use only after ruling out the main prompt and configuration
HighLevel warns that edits require ongoing maintenance
Change the narrowest module and preserve safe defaults
Keep a copy and rollback plan
validation: Run focused module scenarios plus regression tests for unrelated foundational behavior
Use Reset to Default if the change degrades performance

suggestions.title: Correct outbound disclosure, purpose, or workflow targeting
suggestions.uiPath: Build > Outbound Settings and Automation > Voice AI Outbound Call
signals: The recipient does not understand why they were called
The agent proceeds without required disclosure
The wrong contacts, workflow, agent, or number are used
Voicemail/no-answer handling conflicts with the campaign
guardrails: Treat legal requirements as jurisdiction- and campaign-specific
Do not generate definitive legal advice
Prioritize stopping non-compliant outreach over conversational optimization
validation: Test connected, voicemail, no-answer, opt-out, and wrong-person scenarios with compliance review
